finding_10_drain_window_is_too_tight_for.correction_to_the_guidance: feedback_dispatcher_telemetry_writes_deadlock_inbox_backlog_guard says 'prefer folding the finding into an existing artifact over minting'. finding_10_drain_window_is_too_tight_for.how_to_apply: Decide mint-vs-fold at WRITE time, not after. If a finding arrives post-write, mint — do not attempt to reopen a file the drain may already own.
finding_10_drain_window_is_too_tight_for.the_generalization: A read that confirms a file is live is only valid for as long as nothing else owns the path. This is a TOCTOU on the drain, the same shape as the git-index TOCTOU already recorded.
